g.text: User
User
Browser
Browser
Backend
Backend
Frontend
Frontend
User has a web browser and the address of the page.
Frontend has a full catalog of text for English and for German.
User opens the page of the application.
Browser sends the list of the preferred languages to Frontend.
Frontend selects the language of the page and shows User the page with the choice of the language.
This is the use case Choose the Language, steps 2 and 3.
parallel: View the System Status
Frontend sends the request GET /status to Backend.
This is the use case View the System Status. Frontend sends the request GET /info (step 4) at the same time. Each section of the page waits for its own response.
Backend sends the state of the system and the time of the check to Frontend.
alt
[Backend sends an error response for the status, or it gives no response]
Frontend shows User the error text in the section of the status.
Continue to step 6.
[parallel: View the Version and the License Notice]
Frontend sends the request GET /info to Backend.
This is the use case View the Version and the License Notice.
Backend sends the version, the commit, the copyright holder, the address of the repository and the license to Frontend.
The sequence of the two responses can be different. The sections of the page do not wait for each other.
alt
[Backend sends an error response for the information, or it gives no response]
Frontend shows User the error text in the section of the notice.
Continue to step 7.
Frontend shows User the state, the time of the check, the notice of the license, the version and the commit, in the language of the page.
User reads the page.
User selects the other language with its button.
Frontend shows User all text of the page in the other language.
The page shows the state of the system and the time of the check.
The page shows the notice of the license, the version and the commit.
All text of the page is in the language of User.
Each section that did not get its information shows the heading that the information is not available, and the text for the cause.
The other sections of the page are not changed by this failure.
